result.title: Where Latents Belong and How They Flow: Joint Identification of Structural Roles
result.summary: Latent factors in dynamical systems can play different roles across observations and time. For example, an idea in a group meeting may be expressed by only some participants, inherit information from earlier discussions, and shape what is said next. We formalize this notion as the structural role of a latent factor, describing where it is expressed, whether it receives influence from the past, and whether it transmits influence to the future. The main challenge is correspondence, since the three structures may be identified under different permutations, while a structural role is defined only when they are aligned to the same latent coordinate. We show that, under suitable structural and variability conditions, all three roles are jointly identifiable under a common permutation at each time point. Guided by this theory, we develop RoleTrace, a framework that traces structural roles in a shared latent coordinate system. Synthetic experiments validate structural recovery, while experiments on multiparty meetings examine the identified roles in real sequential interactions.

AI.brief_summary: 论文将潜变量的「结构角色」形式化为三方面：在哪里被表达、是否接收过去的影响、是否向未来传递影响，并在结构性与变异性条件下证明三者可在同一置换下联合可识别，据此提出 RoleTrace，在共享潜坐标系中追踪这些角色，用合成数据和多人会议序列验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「跨时间识别潜坐标的表达与影响流向」可供核查 LVR 中哪些内部状态真正承载视觉证据、latent 贡献如何归因以及深度与位置效应，属方法层面的可迁移线索，而非直接研究 VLM 推理。
